note: Direction matters here and the free data is one-sided: ImportKey lists TVH India Private Limited (address '7TH FLR TOWER I FOUNTAINHEAD SN 20 7, PHOENIX MARKET CITY NAGAR ROAD') with 15,109 records, but every rendered row shows TVH India as the Indian importer receiving parts from group entities TVH Parts NV (Belgium, 8,117 shipments), TVH Parts Co (Kansas City, USA, 2,632), TVH Brasil (392) — top ports Antwerpen 3460, NHAVA SHEVA SEA 2990, BRUSSELS 1556, Kansas City 1255. That is an inbound distribution footprint, not proof of Indian-origin exports. Declared HS 843139 and 848390 (parts of lifting/handling machinery, gearing) are plausible for this business, but the HS codes actually visible on the records are 84099990, 84312090, 73181500 and 81122900 — none matches the declared pair, and all are on import entries. Conclusion per Rule 5: no trace of export shipments found; domestic supply unverified. Slug variants tried: tvh-india-private-limited (populated), tvh-india-pvt-ltd (empty shell), tvh-india-private-ltd (empty shell). volza, eximpedia and trademo free views all returned HTTP 403, so no second-source cross-check was possible.
